evidence: Carries the Scripts and tools label and modifies contrib/verify-binaries/verify.py and test.py.
rationale: Fixes a security flaw in binary verification where expired or revoked keys counted toward quorum. As reported via Red Team disclosure, the verifier 'counted signatures with EXPKEYSIG or REVKEYSIG statuses toward the --min-good-sigs threshold, allowing binary verification to succeed entirely on expired or revoked keys.'
